description: This file implements static methods for the IWorkerPool interface within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, managing a singleton instance of a worker pool.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::Assign
methods.description: Assigns an instance to the singleton worker pool pointer, with an assertion to ensure proper state.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton worker pool instance, asserting it is not null.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the singleton worker pool instance is available (not null).
